summary: Swamp and bunker-based Black Ops 3 Zombies map built around buckets, water colors, plant growth, bunker progression, Pack-a-Punch, the Skull of Nan Sapwe, KT-4, Masamune, trials, a simple but setup-heavy main easter egg, and many side easter eggs.

files.summary: Overall map overview, core systems, layout, setup priorities, and how Zetsubou's many mechanics connect.
How to fill the generators, enter the bunker, activate power, collect the 3 Pack-a-Punch parts, and unlock Pack-a-Punch.
Bucket basics, the blue, green, purple, and rainbow water sources, and how bucket charges and water collection work.
Plant encyclopedia covering no-water plants, blue, green, and purple plants, fruit plants, fertilized variants, mimic plants, and mixed-color growth rules.
How to build the KT-4 by collecting spider venom, the green glowing flask, and the underwater flower.
How to upgrade the KT-4 into the Masamune using the spider tooth, rainbow-water plant step, electrified shield panel, and Element 115 flask.
How to complete the 4 skull cleansing rituals and the final cave ritual to obtain the Skull of Nan Sapwe.
Trials of the Ancients overview, rewards, full list of trial types, strategy notes, and electric shield requirement.
How to build the shield from the 3 parts found in Lab A, Lab B, and the AA gun balcony area.
How to build the Gas Mask from the cable, mask, and filter, and why it is useful for spores and underwater sections.
Full Zetsubou No Shima main easter egg guide, including the shell plant, plane cannon gear, zipline gear, Anywhere But Here gear, elevator repair, and boss fight.
How to activate the first secret song, Dead Flowers, by interacting with the 3 puppets.
How to activate the second secret song, Samantha's Lullaby, by filling the underground wall pockets with the correct water amounts.
How to obtain the Golden Bucket by revealing the special grow spot, placing the bucket, and feeding the plant sequence.
How to transform into a spider using the Skull, KT-4, electrified shield, and special Lab A cage process.
How spore gas hallucinations work and where they can be seen on the map.
How to create a friendly blue-eyed Thrasher using the Masamune and the hidden green-tanks room wall setup.
How to trigger the doppelganger jumpscare by aiming at the test subject in the green tank room with a sniper rifle.
How to see the distant swamp monster shadow outside the map around round 50.
How to get Widow's Wine for free after defeating the giant spider during the Masamune setup.
